title: Who has already taken care of the pet
description: A shared log of walks, feedings and care with an author for every entry.

blocks.text: The question “have you fed him yet?” comes up because there is no shared history. One account for everybody can only add to the confusion.

quote.text: Why can only one person be logged in at a time? Every time either me or my husband logs in, it has to log the other of us out and then always have to log back in.

blocks.text: Every participant has their own sign-in. After an action a short entry appears with the pet and the time; if the update is late, that is visible. A sitter can be given only the days and the information they need.
Filters must not quietly hide today’s events. Handing over the care starts with a shared overview.
